title: Palacio · Matemágico despierta
description: The wrapper room, from the palace scenario: the unwinnable fight, Bernat's cry («Pensa, Gerard! Fes la màgia amb la teva ment!») wakes Matemágico, Foc Binari melts the minion's gum, the fight is won and the ambush follows.

steps.caption: The minion climbs out of the drain

steps.caption: Un esbirro de verdad: every hit is swallowed

steps.eval: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const b = document.querySelector('#battle'); for (let i = 0; i < 2000 && !b.dataset.beat; i++) { const attack = b.querySelector('[data-command="attack"] .command-trigger'); const target = b.querySelector('.battle-target[data-side="foes"]:not(:disabled)'); if (target) target.click(); else if (!attack.disabled) attack.click(); await sleep(400); } })()

steps.caption: Bernat: «Pensa, Gerard! Fes la màgia amb la teva ment!»

The fire lands and the gum melts; one circle of Ánima spent

steps.eval: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const b = document.querySelector('#battle'); for (let i = 0; i < 600 && b.querySelector('.battle-result').hidden; i++) { const fire = b.querySelector('.skill-flyout:not([inert]) [data-skill="foc-binari"]:not([aria-disabled])'); const skill = b.querySelector('[data-command="skill"] .command-trigger'); const attack = b.querySelector('[data-command="attack"] .command-trigger'); const target = b.querySelector('.battle-target[data-side="foes"]:not(:disabled)'); if (target) target.click(); else if (fire) fire.click(); else if (!skill.disabled && !b.querySelector('.command.expanded')) skill.click(); else if (!attack.disabled) attack.click(); await sleep(400); } })()
